answer.explanation: The $3,600 confocal microscope service contract (rq-104) was held for the grant manager. It failed "Grant is active and not frozen" because R01GM000001 was canceled 2026-03-10, a court restored it on 2026-04-20, but no payment has arrived since, so spending stays frozen. It also failed "Shared cost split across the grants it serves" because it serves R01GM000001 and R21AI000002 but is charged to R01GM000001 only (NSF OIG audit summary: shared costs charged 100% to one award). Next, the cost must be split between the two grants by use; send the split and it will be checked again.
